display_name: Reinstate a withdrawn model capability catalog cell
description: Operator ruling rul_2bff72b8 (full lifecycle verbs). Use it to return a withdrawn catalog cell, or every withdrawn effort of one model on a runtime, to dispatch with the capability_score, cost_per_task_usd and measured_at it kept. Sets acceptance to accepted, keeps the original accepted_at (or stamps now when the cell never had one) and clears the withdrawal note. Required: runtime, model, reason (not blank, at most 512 characters), expected_acceptance (must be withdrawn) and actor. effort is optional; omitted means every effort of the model. Refused with parameter_invalid when a target kept no capability_score: there is nothing to reopen, so record the cell with record_model_capability_cell instead. Same guard as withdraw_model_capability_cell: a predicated update on id, acceptance and updated_at, every target checked before any write, stale_cell_state when a cell is no longer withdrawn. The reinstated reading is not renewed: it keeps its old measured_at, so select_dispatch_tier serves it with a stale-reading advisory when it is past its window. Each returned cell carries refresh_outlook: undone_by_next_refresh is true when the cell's harness absence clock is set and its window has passed (the next refresh withdraws it again unless the harness lists the model), false when no clock is set or the window has not ended, and null when the clock is unreadable. Evidence: a manual refresh-run row and one acceptance_change observation per cell.
embedding_description: Undoing an earlier retirement of a model after it came back: restore the withdrawn capability-table row so dispatch can choose it again at the score it kept, and find out whether the next automatic refresh would retire it again.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: run_id, runtime, model, acceptance (always accepted), cells (per cell: effort, from_acceptance, to_acceptance, the retained values, observation_id, and refresh_outlook with undone_by_next_refresh and a detail sentence), reason, actor, reversal (the verb that withdraws the cells again).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Name each reinstated cell as model@effort with its retained score and measured_at. When refresh_outlook.undone_by_next_refresh is true, say so first and quote its detail; when it is null, say the outcome is not known. Say that an old measured_at is served with a stale-reading advisory, not refused.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: select_dispatch_tier can serve the cell at once. If the outlook says the next refresh withdraws it again, the harness has to list the model again or the cell must be recorded afresh with record_model_capability_cell. To undo it, call withdraw_model_capability_cell.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One manual refresh-run row, one predicated update of each target cell and one acceptance_change observation per cell, all through the state interface. Not retryable: a retry after a transient fault whose write already landed would open a second run row.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: parameter_invalid: runtime is not claude_code or codex; model, effort when given, reason or actor is blank; reason is over 512 characters; expected_acceptance is not withdrawn; or a target cell kept no capability_score. cell_not_found: no catalog cell matches. stale_cell_state: a target cell is no longer withdrawn or changed after it was read; nothing was moved by that check. catalog_invalid: a cell row had no updated_at or an observation insert returned no generated id. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For a missing score, call record_model_capability_cell with the reading and its source. For stale_cell_state, read the cell again with read_model_capability_catalog (include_unaccepted true) and decide again. For catalog_invalid, read_model_capability_history shows whether the move landed; the run row may be left status running.
